subject.title: [Feature]: Add Korean (ko) language support to Control UI and AI agent

question: Should OpenClaw add agent-wide primary-language persistence and automatic Korean-aware search defaults now that the Korean Control UI locale has shipped?
rationale: The remaining request changes default agent prompt/search behavior for all users and providers, and the paired PR was closed for mixing localization with default agent prompt behavior.

options.title: Require a narrow policy proposal first
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers approve the prompt/search policy shape and a reporter supplies a redacted Korean transcript or live proof.

options.title: Limit this issue to shipped UI localization
options.body: Treat the Control UI locale as complete and ask for a separate issue with concrete proof for agent-language drift.

options.title: Approve a direct agent-language implementation
options.body: Allow a focused PR to add same-language prompt/search behavior with tests, accepting the cross-language policy impact.

recommendation.title: Require a narrow policy proposal first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers approve the prompt/search policy shape and a reporter supplies a redacted Korean transcript or live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc owns the strongest observed i18n history and already gave scope guidance on the paired PR.
